metaphor: the bingo dauber: a find is dabbed with translucent ink, not checked
category_convention_avoided: nature apps: white canvas, forest-green accent, rounded photo-on-top cards, pill buttons, leaf icons; bingo apps: primary colours and bubbly type
design_code: Photos stay full colour and are never dimmed, because the card exists to help someone recognise the thing in the field.
The dab is purple (hue 282) because it must be the one colour the October landscape is not wearing, so a dab is never read as part of a photo.
Counts and times are tabular, because the time of each find is the record of the walk.
expressive_axis: ink: the translucent dab is the only loud element
structure: one card: header strip (wordmark, place, tally) over a 4x4 bingo grid (2 columns under 640px), notes below
depth: flat tiles on the ground; the dab is translucent ink with a soft wet edge; no shadows
ornament: the photographs plus the dab marks

motion.explains: a find was recorded; the tally changed
motion.signature: the dab lands: scale 1.35 to 0.94 to 1 with a gentle overshoot over 420ms, ink opacity rises as it lands
motion.load: tiles drift up 6px and settle, 24ms stagger

numerals: tabular; times as h:mm am/pm; tally as N of 16
